73:1: O you wrapped in your cloak!
73:2: Stand the night, except for a little while.
73:3: Half of the night, or reduce from it a little, or add to it a little.
73:4: Or increase it, and recite the Qur'an slowly and distinctly.
73:5: Indeed, We reveal to you a heavy word.
73:6: Indeed, the rising of the night is more effective and firmer in speech.
73:7: Indeed, for you in the daytime there is a prolonged occupation.
73:8: Remember the name of your Rabb, and leave everything and turn only to Him.
73:9: He is the Rabb of the east and the west, there is no god but Him, so take Him as trustee.
73:10: Be patient over what they say, and depart from them with a graceful departure.
73:11: Leave Me and the deniers who possess comfort, and give them respite for a little.
73:12: Indeed, with Us are shackles and a Hell.
73:13: There is also a food that chokes the throat and a painful punishment.
73:14: On that Day the earth and the mountains tremble, and the mountains have become a poured-out heap of sand.
73:15: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger witnessing over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
73:16: Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, so We seized him in a severe manner.
73:17: Then how will you protect yourselves, if you disbelieve, from that Day that makes children white-haired?
73:18: The heaven is torn apart by it; His promise has been fulfilled.
73:19: Indeed, this is an admonition; so whoever wills takes a way to his Rabb.
73:20: Indeed, your Rabb knows that you stand less than two thirds of the night, half of it, and a third of it, and a group of those with you also stand. Allah determines the night and the day. He knew that you would not be able to count it, so He turned to you in mercy. So recite what is easy from the Qur'an. He knew that there will be sick among you, and others traveling through the land seeking the bounty of Allah, and others fighting in the way of Allah. So recite what is easy from it, establish the salah, give the zakat, and lend Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah as better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness from Allah. Indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
